_comment: Decision constants for A/B design 2 (verify-before-fix gate). Written once from plan sections 2-3 and owner decisions D1-D6; read by harness.py analyze. No threshold literal appears in code.
_B_BASE_comment: B_BASE = A_BASE + AUD_BASE (loop + one audit). Reported only, never decides (D2).
_B_defaults_comment: Single-audit defaults from section 2. analyze recomputes B_BLK, B_AUDFAIL and B_THEME over all existing baseline audits (audit 1 + $SP/p12/baseline-audit2) and uses those; the defaults apply (labelled PROVISIONAL) only if no second audit exists.
_COST_LIMIT_comment: D6: original limit L = 1.25 was stated against total tokens (R_B). R_LOOP_limit = (L * 169468 - 69044) / 100424 = (1.25 * 169468 - 69044) / 100424 = 1.4219 -> 1.42. Applies to DROP-2 and ADOPT. Judged only after runs complete (post-hoc); no mid-run cost check exists anywhere in the tooling.

rules._comment: DROP3_PASS_MIN: DROP-3 fires when loop PASS (PASS + VERIFIED-PASS) count is below this (5/6 at n=6, 8/9 at n=9). MIN_COMPLETED: fewer completed runs than this is INCONCLUSIVE.

haiku._comment: Haiku test harness-failure rate (runs lost or needing a MANUAL relaunch, per run) may be at most this far above the Haiku baseline's (3b).
